META.text: Meta fell about 3.5% as the broader AI selloff was amplified by fresh concern that rapidly rising infrastructure spending could pressure free cash flow before the returns on that investment become visible.

NVDA.text: Nvidia fell about 3.9% with the global semiconductor rout as investors questioned stretched AI valuations and reacted to new competitive pressure from cheaper Chinese AI models.

AVGO.text: Broadcom fell about 7.3% mainly with the semiconductor-sector unwind, as investors reduced exposure to highly valued AI infrastructure names rather than reacting to a distinct Broadcom announcement.

PLTR.text: No verified company-specific catalyst emerged; Palantir’s roughly 4.4% gain was an idiosyncratic rebound against a falling Nasdaq, so the precise driver remains unresolved.

SPCX.text: SpaceX fell about 14.7% as post-IPO selling intensified and a Starship test was aborted after multiple engines failed to ignite, reinforcing near-term execution and valuation concerns.

MU.text: Micron fell about 13.3% as the memory trade reversed after SK Hynix’s sharp selloff, with profit-taking spreading across memory and storage stocks after an exceptional rally.
